infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Job Tracker uses your location to confirm you're on-site when you clock in or out of a job.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Job Tracker can check your location in the background so clock-in reminders and geofenced arrival detection work even when the app isn't open.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Job Tracker needs camera access to take job-site and receipt photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Job Tracker needs photo library access to attach existing photos to a job or expense.
